notes: CUET (UG) 2026 domain syllabi were taken from the official NTA page https://cuet.nta.nic.in/cuetug-2026-syllabus/ ; the PDFs themselves are hosted on cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in (Government of India S3 CDN) and are linked from that NTA page - nature: official.

IMPORTANT code correction: per the official CUET 2026 PDF titles, Accountancy/Book-Keeping = 301, Business Studies = 305, Economics/Business Economics = 309. The original ledger pass assumed 309=Business Studies and 305=Economics (swapped). Topics here are attached by the OFFICIAL current code: cuet-ug-309 = Economics/Business Economics, cuet-ug-305 = Business Studies.

NCERT/CBSE class 11-12 unit lists were taken from the current CBSE Senior Secondary curriculum 2026-27 PDFs on cbseacademic.nic.in (the PDFs themselves state they apply to both 2025-26 and 2026-27 sessions). ncert.nic.in was unreachable from this research environment, so NCERT textbook tables of contents were NOT independently fetched; chapter-level lines for Accountancy come from chapter headings named inside the CBSE syllabus PDFs (nature: official).

CBSE Economics was restructured (from 2025-26, continuing in 2026-27): Class XI = Part A Statistics for Economics + Part B Introductory Microeconomics; Class XII = Part A Introductory Macroeconomics + Part B Indian Economic Development. The four NCERT books remain prescribed (Statistics for Economics; Indian Economic Development; Introductory Microeconomics; Introductory Macroeconomics) but are redistributed across classes; ncert-econ-11 / ncert-econ-12 below therefore follow the CURRENT class-wise official syllabus, not the older book-grade pairing (XI: Stats+IED; XII: Micro+Macro).

Current CBSE Accountancy syllabus (2025-26/2026-27) no longer contains Bills of Exchange (Class XI), Accounting for Not-for-Profit Organisations (Class XII), or a standalone Accounting Ratios unit (ratios now sit inside Analysis of Financial Statements; only a stale rationale line still mentions NPO). Class XII offers Computerised Accounting as an alternative Part B. NCERT textbook chapters may still carry some of these titles.

Business Studies Class XI Unit 1 is named 'Nature and Purpose of Business' in the CBSE marks table but 'Evolution and Fundamentals of Business' in the content section (NCERT chapter: 'Business, Trade and Commerce') - both names recorded on one line. Class XII 'Marketing' appears as 'Marketing Management' in the marks table. Class XI Unit 10 content header reads 'International Trade' while the marks table and NCERT chapter read 'International Business'.

CBSE 2026-27 syllabi continue to track NCERT's rationalised (2023-24) textbook editions: e.g., no 'Non-competitive Markets' in Introductory Microeconomics, no 'Poverty'/'Infrastructure' in Indian Economic Development (CBSE unit coverage confirms the reduced chapter set).

CUET 2026 Business Studies covers only Class-12-style management/finance/marketing units (no Class 11 foundations); CUET Accountancy covers only partnership/company accounts and financial-statement analysis (Class 12 level); CUET Economics = Micro + Macro + Indian Economic Development (no Statistics).
'Project Work' is a named Part C component of each CBSE syllabus and is recorded as a topic line; CUET domain syllabi carry no project component.
No mirrors were needed - every syllabus line below comes from an official NTA/CBSE document fetched directly.
